SELECT i.id, r.rec_date, r.id reception_id, o.number order_no, pt.name point, p.name partner, p.type partner_type, p.cui partner_cui, p.id partner_id,
    i.article_id, a.name article, a.sku, e.code ewc, i.lot, i.kg, i.pcs, i.price, i.org_id, g.code org_code, g.name org_name, g.type org_type, g.positions, m.position, r.siatd_sent
    FROM reception_items i JOIN receptions r ON r.id = i.reception_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = i.article_id LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = i.ewc_id
    LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN points pt ON pt.id = r.point_id LEFT JOIN orgs g ON g.id = i.org_id LEFT JOIN org_map m ON m.article_id = i.article_id AND m.org_id = i.org_id
    WHERE r.status = 'finalizata' AND r.rec_date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND {0} ORDER BY r.rec_date, i.id

    FROM treat_inputs i JOIN treat_ops o ON o.id = i.op_id JOIN treat_sessions ss ON ss.id = o.session_id JOIN stock s ON s.id = i.stock_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = s.ewc_id
    WHERE o.status = 'inchisa' AND ss.day BETWEEN ? AND ? AND {0} ORDER BY ss.day, o.id

    WHERE o.status = 'inchisa' AND ss.day BETWEEN ? AND ? AND {0} ORDER BY ss.day, o.id

SELECT x.left_at, x.number, o.number order_no, p.name partner, p.cui partner_cui, d.name dest, a.name article, e.code ewc, i.kg
    FROM shipment_items i JOIN shipments x ON x.id = i.shipment_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = x.order_id JOIN stock s ON s.id = i.stock_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id
    LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = s.ewc_id LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN points d ON d.id = o.dest_point_id
    WHERE x.status IN ('plecata','livrata','confirmata','finalizata') AND substr(x.left_at, 1, 10) BETWEEN ? AND ? AND {0} ORDER BY x.left_at
